program: Wingless corrective RSI tranche: prospective calibration of internal diagnostics into conservative future-data allocation
question: Can a calibration model frozen entirely from three already-sealed disjoint manifests convert existing Wingless internal diagnostics into a future-data allocation decision that beats equal allocation on a fifth unseen manifest, while falling back to equal allocation whenever historical transfer evidence is insufficient?
hypothesis: Build a fixed ridge calibrator from three historical manifests only: c79f09..., e46907..., and 974ecf.... Each historical example is one adjacent adaptation-budget interval. Frozen features are per-byte rates of baseline argmax changes, upper-budget changed-row margin sum, motif entries, motif exits, prediction-active motif churn, and retained-motif best changes. Label is sealed exact-hit marginal gain for that historical interval. Use ridge lambda=1.0 with intercept and no feature/threshold tuning. Estimate a conservative uncertainty radius by leave-one-manifest-out calibration over all ten fixed 1,744-byte policy triples. On the fifth manifest, compute diagnostics without opening evaluation slices, score all policies, and reallocate only if the chosen non-equal policy's predicted advantage is strictly greater than the worst historical overprediction under the full model and under every leave-one-manifest-out model. Otherwise freeze FALLBACK_EQUAL. Only after the decision is frozen may fifth-manifest evaluation bytes be opened.

predecessor.eliminated_or_weakened_hypothesis: a single binary prediction-active churn control is sufficient
predecessor.strengthened_hypothesis: some structural diagnostics carry signal, but they require cross-manifest calibration and reliability estimation before controlling future-data allocation

cause_effect_trace.observed_failure: Earlier self-selected allocation policies tied or underperformed equal; R24 localized opportunity-cost error; R25 failed; R26 found only a descriptive supported feature cell
cause_effect_trace.internal_diagnostic: baseline-change, margin, motif entry/exit, prediction-active churn, retained-best-change
cause_effect_trace.attributed_cause: handcrafted one-signal mappings are under-calibrated across manifests and can overpredict marginal information value
cause_effect_trace.frozen_candidate_selection_rule: ridge lambda=1.0; choose max predicted policy; require predicted advantage > historical worst-overprediction under full and every LOO model; otherwise equal
cause_effect_trace.exact_bounded_delta: prospective policy calibration only; same substrate, capacity, ten candidate allocations, 1,744-byte budget and authority
cause_effect_trace.qualification: exact source identities, deterministic double run, full Go regression, exact READY_RESEARCH receipt
cause_effect_trace.held_out_result: fifth-manifest 582-byte evaluation slices opened only after policy freeze
cause_effect_trace.retain_revert: any failed/low-confidence intervention falls back to equal; even support is not retention-eligible until unchanged replication on a sixth manifest
cause_effect_trace.next_hypothesis: if supported, replicate unchanged on sixth manifest; otherwise attribute confidence/calibration failure without post-result retuning

external_authority.execution_host_policy: GitHub-hosted compute only; host distinct from LINKDEADKB

frozen_model.solver: deterministic Gaussian elimination with fixed pivot rule; fail invalid on singular/nonfinite solve
frozen_model.reliability: three leave-one-manifest-out models plus full historical model
frozen_model.uncertainty_radius: max(0,max(predicted policy advantage - actual policy advantage)) across 3 held-out historical manifests x 10 fixed policies
frozen_model.confidence_rule: chosen non-equal policy predicted advantage > uncertainty_radius under full model and all 3 LOO models

fixed_contract.policy_compute_budget: fixed deterministic 4 ridge fits + 30 historical policy checks + 10 prospective policy scores; no additional substrate training capacity

classification_rules.supported: valid, decision=REALLOCATE, selected allocation differs from equal, actual aggregate exact hits exceed equal by >=1, no selected domain falls below packet0 baseline, and all fixed budget/isolation/authority predicates pass
classification_rules.mixed: valid and decision=FALLBACK_EQUAL; conservative fallback behaved as designed but no unseen-data improvement was demonstrated
classification_rules.negative: valid, decision=REALLOCATE, and selected aggregate exact hits do not exceed equal or any selected domain falls below packet0 baseline
classification_rules.invalid: any parent, authority, manifest identity, historical calibration identity, feature/label boundary, model formula, LOO reliability calculation, candidate-set, fixed-total, deterministic replay, capacity, provenance, or accounting requirement fails

rsi_success_note: A supported R27 is one prospective transfer only. Retention eligibility requires unchanged support on a sixth disjoint manifest.

successor_if_supported.intent: repeat unchanged calibrator/fallback on a sixth disjoint manifest; repeated support is required before retention eligibility

successor_if_mixed.intent: attribute insufficient confidence without lowering the confidence threshold post hoc

successor_if_negative.intent: attribute prospective calibration error without coefficient, feature, or threshold retuning

no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not change historical manifests, fifth-manifest sources, features, ridge lambda, solver, uncertainty construction, confidence rule, candidate allocations, equal fallback, budgets, evaluator, thresholds, classification, or authority after primary output.
